title: BYO corpus record — slack
description: A Slack message. Title is optional (messages have no title). A record with `replies` becomes a thread root; each reply is served via conversations.replies and only the root shows in conversations.history.

content.description: The retrieval payload served verbatim as the body.

channel.description: The channel this document belongs to (default: the source_type).

group.description: ACL group owning the channel (default: slug(container)); null means the container owns no group, so nothing is group-scoped to it.

author_name.description: The author's display name, used for their principal entry (this API exposes no owner display name on the document itself).

visibility.description: public = org-wide, group = the container's group, private = author only.

readers.description: Explicit reader principals. `user:<email>` / `group:<id>` / `org:<name>` state the type; unprefixed, an address is a user and anything else a group. Overrides visibility — and an EMPTY array means nobody may read the document (admin-only), not everybody.

edited.description: {user, ts} if the message was edited.

created.description: Creation time (epoch seconds or ISO 8601). Default: synthesized from doc_id. Sets the message ts. A thread reply times itself: its own `created` when it has one, else one second after the message before it.

items.description: A threaded reply — a full message that inherits the root's channel and ACL. Carries the same fields a root message can (reactions, files, subtype, edited); its time is its own `created` when given, else one second after the message before it.

doc_id.description: Optional stable id for the reply.

created.description: Reply time (default: one second after the previous message). Must be after the message before it: a Slack ts is identity as well as clock, so a thread's times are strictly increasing.

edited.description: {user, ts} if the reply was edited.

participants.description: Who takes part in this conversation. Thread-level, so it belongs on the root message only.
